name: Reading out what models secretly think
gist: Models encode information in their internal activations—patterns they notice, knowledge they have, reasoning they do. These papers translate that internal code into human language.
explain: Inside a model's computation, information is encoded in a numerical format that computers can process but humans cannot read. The numbers in a hidden layer don't look like English words or ideas. But they must encode something — patterns the model noticed, knowledge it extracted from training data, hypotheses about the input. Some researchers use other neural networks to translate this internal code into human language. You can take a specific internal state, pass it to a separate decoder network (a small model trained to output descriptions), and ask it to generate a sentence describing what that state represents.

This is helpful because it lets a language model help us understand another language model. But it's also risky: the decoder itself might hallucinate. It might describe features that don't really exist or get the meaning subtly wrong. Researchers validate by checking whether the decoded descriptions actually predict the original model's behavior: if the decoded description is accurate, the original model should act consistently with it. Some papers also use prompting: activating the model to 'think aloud' about what it's computing at each step. The challenge is making sure the translation is faithful, not just plausible-sounding.

papers.title: Belief Dynamics Reveal the Dual Nature of In-Context Learning and Activation Steering
papers.contribution: Explains empirical phenomena like sigmoidal learning curves and predicts novel ones including additivity in log-belief space and distinct behavioral shift phases from intervention control changes.

papers.title: CB-SLICE: Concept-Based Interpretable Error Slice Discovery
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods in uncovering well-known biases while providing richer and more faithful explanations directly linked to error sources.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Redundancy and the Geometry of Vision–Language Embeddings
papers.contribution: Reveals vision-language embedding structure where bimodal atoms carry alignment signal, unimodal atoms explain modality gap, and restricting vector arithmetic to bimodal subspace improves retrieval.

papers.title: Debugging Concept Bottleneck Models through Removal and Retraining
papers.contribution: CBDebug significantly outperforms prior retraining methods across PIP-Net and Post-hoc CBM architectures on datasets with known spurious correlations.

papers.title: Navigating the Latent Space Dynamics of Neural Models
papers.contribution: The latent vector field representation enables analyzing generalization and memorization regimes throughout training, extracting prior knowledge from network parameters via attractors without requiring input data, and identifying out-of-distribution samples fr

papers.title: The Deleuzian Representation Hypothesis
papers.contribution: Achieves concept quality surpassing prior unsupervised SAE variants while approaching supervised baselines across five models and three modalities.

papers.title: The Geometry of Representational Failures in Vision Language Models
papers.contribution: Geometric overlap between concept vectors correlates strongly with error patterns, offering a quantitative framework to understand how internal representations shape VLM behavior.

papers.title: Transformers learn factored representations
papers.contribution: Conditionally independent factors lead to factored representations with linear dimensionality growth, while dependencies cause models to gradually expand dimensionality for fidelity.

papers.title: A Geometric Analysis of Small-sized Language Model Hallucinations
papers.contribution: We classify hallucinations with F1>90% from 30-50 annotations, releasing SOCRATES-300K dataset of 300k labeled responses for studying geometric hallucination signatures.

papers.title: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
papers.contribution: AI engrams enable surgical manipulation of learned knowledge via linear arithmetic; experiments from MLPs to LLMs demonstrate causal validity and scalability.

papers.title: Adaptive Concept Discovery for Interpretable Few-Shot Text Classification
papers.contribution: With only 10 training samples, achieves performance comparable to LLMs while providing interpretable concept-based predictions.

papers.title: Bridging the Knowledge-Prediction Gap in LLMs on Multiple-Choice Questions
papers.contribution: Reduces knowledge-prediction gap across diverse MCQ benchmarks and models, generalizing to free-form settings with geometric interpretation.

papers.title: Characterizing and Mitigating Reasoning Drift in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Effectively mitigates reasoning drift and boosts accuracy while generalizing to out-of-distribution tasks, capturing deeper principles of valid reasoning.

papers.title: Escaping Low-Rank Traps: Interpretable Visual Concept Learning via Implicit Vector Quantization
papers.contribution: The method prevents representational collapse and achieves state-of-the-art performance on eight diverse benchmarks with clearer, more interpretable cross-modal representations.

papers.title: ForensicConcept: Transferable Forensic Concepts for AIGI Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent improvements on GenImage, GAN-family, and Chameleon benchmarks with auditable evidence readouts and principled explanation for why certain backbones yield more transferable forensic concepts.

papers.title: Imagination Helps Visual Reasoning, But Not Yet in Latent Space
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that explicit imagination outperforms complex latent-space baselines on vision-centric benchmarks, challenging necessity of latent reasoning.

papers.title: Interpretable Self-Supervised Learning via Representer Landmarks and Nyström Approximation
papers.contribution: Enables direct audit of SSL objectives (SimCLR, BYOL, VICReg) without supervision; reveals algorithmic bias in Adult-1M dataset where SSL uses demographic proxies; Nyström approximation enables 1M+ sample scalability.

papers.title: LLM Self-Recognition: Steering and Retrieving Activation Signatures
papers.contribution: Achieves over 98% accuracy on LLM identification across multiple settings while preserving generated text quality without semantic interference.

papers.title: Learning Concept Bottleneck Models from Mechanistic Explanations
papers.contribution: M-CBMs consistently surpass prior CBMs at matched sparsity while improving concept predictions and providing concise explanations across diverse datasets.

papers.title: Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that varying expression count and functional form provides a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off.

papers.title: Old Habits Die Hard: How Conversational History Geometrically Traps LLMs
papers.contribution: Reveals that behavioral persistence manifests as a geometric trap where latent space gaps confine the model's trajectory, with strong correlation between probabilistic and geometric measures.

papers.title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
papers.contribution: Achieved performance close to or exceeding prompt steering while maintaining interpretability on persona steering and instruction following.

papers.title: Steer Where It Matters: Token-Level Visual-Sensitivity Steering for LVLMs Hallucination Mitigation
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent improvements on POPE, AMBER, CHAIR, MMHal and HallusionBench benchmarks.

papers.title: Steering at the Source: Style Modulation Heads for Robust Persona Control
papers.contribution: Achieves robust behavioral control with significantly reduced coherency degradation while maintaining safety through component-level localization.

papers.title: The Geometry and Topology of Circuits: the Manifolds of Modular Addition
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that uniform and trainable attention architectures implement the same algorithm via topologically equivalent representations across hundreds of circuits.

papers.title: The Shape of Adversarial Influence: Characterizing LLM Latent Spaces with Persistent Homology
papers.contribution: Reveals consistent topological compression across architectures where latent spaces collapse from varied features into fewer dominant ones.
